name: discord-mute-bot
description: DiscordMute Bot - Among Us voice mute controller

scripts.dev: bun run generate:commands && bun run --watch src/index.ts
scripts.build: bun run generate:commands && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile bot.exe
scripts.deploy: bun run generate:commands && bun run src/deploy-commands.ts
